facts.fact: FrontPage Africa says the Central Bank of Liberia spearheaded the launch of the Inclusive Instant Payment System, a nationwide mobile money interoperability platform, with the World Bank supporting a full National Electronic Payment Switch.

Cross-border transactions are only listed as a future phase.

facts.fact: FrontPage Africa says the IIPS pilot phase currently supports government-to-people transactions.
FrontPage Africa says the IIPS launched on Tuesday as a nationwide mobile money interoperability platform, with the pilot phase supporting person-to-person transactions.
FrontPage Africa says work is ongoing with the Liberia Revenue Authority to roll out people-to-government payments on the IIPS.
